## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue/feature ticket. Specify which parts of the codebase were modified or created.

Fixes # (issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Architectural refactoring / code cleanup (no functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification Checklist

Before submitting this Pull Request, please verify:
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and resolved all errors/warnings.
- [ ] I have run `npx tsc --noEmit` and verified compile safety.
- [ ] All unit tests pass successfully (`npx vitest run`).
- [ ] I have checked the build successfully (`npm run build`).
- [ ] I have tested this feature manually and it works as expected.
- [ ] My changes do not expose any private secrets, tokens, or personal information.
